units.source_text: 她最感到亲切的是真一坐在彩车上的那副童男的形象。

en.t: What felt most intimate to her was the image of Shinichi as the young festival boy riding on the float.

units.source_text: 每逢过节，听到祇园的奏乐声，或看见被许多灯笼照着的彩车，她就马上回忆起真一那副形象来。

en.t: Whenever the festival came, if she heard the music of Gion or saw a float lit by many lanterns, she immediately remembered Shinichi in that form.

units.source_text: 那时，真一和千重子都是七八岁的孩子。

en.t: At that time, Shinichi and Chieko were both children of seven or eight.
